canonicalMutationReview.registrationPolicy: Do not count mutants against source absent from the verification head; register after integration and require an executed exact-head kill.

postal: authenticated DomainDNSError is domain-level sender evidence and must not require message or execution-tag identity
DomainDNSError may be eligible for sender evidence only when authenticated and structurally valid
DomainDNSError must remain ineligible for message reconciliation and carry no business-effect authority
DNS_ERROR and DOMAINDNSERROR must never be accepted as message submission proof or negative-delivery proof
raw DNS error text must not be retained when a digest/minimized representation is sufficient
payment: canonical verified product/SKU identity must be exposed by payment truth and bound into truthDigest
the Lead-Path sprint must require its own canonical product/SKU identity before PAID fulfilment can compile
a valid one-time USD 450 cleared payment for another product must fail closed
product identity must agree across provider order, classification receipt, revenue ledger, canonical truth output, and fulfilment consumer
genome: taskSuccess, reliability, repeatability, evidenceConfidence, quality-like probability fields outside [0,1] must fail closed rather than clamp
negative monetary cost must fail closed rather than score as free or beneficial
negative maintenance, context, or dependency burden must fail closed
invalid economic priors must return ECONOMIC_PRIOR_REJECTED with no executable fitness score

truthRules: Zero-step jobs with runner_id=0 are environment startup failures, not source failures.
No mutation kill is counted unless mutated source executes and the intended test fails for the intended guard.
Exact-head proof is SHA-scoped and does not transfer to a later receipt commit.
Other night branches are inspected read-only and are never overwritten by this lane.
A defect reported by another lane is a verification target until independently executed; it is not an independent mutation kill.
No commercial truth changes without durable real external evidence.
